title: The Water Park
content: Many of the posts on this sub reference a water park. Here is a description of the water park as I know it from my dreams. There is a long pier type walkway along a resort style beach that ends at a large mountain/cliff. Up the cliff is a narrow walkway that leads to the "launch" down a natural waterslide into a big lagoon. The lagoon expands to more water, and beyond that is a large pool/wave pool. There are natural creatures in the lagoon, and people float in tubes. Usually, it's too crowded to wait, and I'm late for checking out or catching my flight. I will make my way back up the pier to the hotel to meet my various family members who are traveling with me.
